<!-- Generated by ModuleDocsGenerator from the annotations of org.hortonmachine.hmachine.geoframe.ermworkflow.ErmStationDataImporter: do not edit, change the annotations and regenerate. -->

Second step of the ERM/GeoFrame water budget workflow: imports the measurements of the meteo stations (temperature and precipitation) and of the stream gauges (discharge) into the GeoFrame database. The data files are CSV time series in the HortonMachine format, with one column per station.

**Toolbox folder:** GeoFrame<br>
**Status:** Certified<br>
**Keywords:** ERM, GeoFrame, meteo, stations, discharge, import<br>
**Class:** `org.hortonmachine.hmachine.geoframe.ermworkflow.ErmStationDataImporter`

**Inputs**

| Parameter | Type | Unit | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `inGpkg` | vector file |  |  | The GeoFrame database created by the data preparation. |
| `pStartTimestamp` | String |  |  | Start of the period to import. Format: yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm, in UTC. |
| `pEndTimestamp` | String |  |  | End of the period to import. Format: yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm, in UTC. |
| `pTimeResolution` | String |  | `HOURLY` | Time resolution of the data: HOURLY or DAILY. |
| `inMeteoStations` | vector file |  |  | The meteo stations (point vector layer). |
| `pMeteoIdField` | String |  | `ID` | Field of the meteo stations layer holding the station id, matching the ids of the CSV columns. |
| `inTemperaturesCsv` | CSV file |  |  | CSV time series of the air temperatures of the meteo stations [°C]. |
| `inPrecipitationCsv` | CSV file |  |  | CSV time series of the precipitations of the meteo stations [mm]. |
| `inStreamGauges` | vector file |  |  | The stream gauges (point vector layer). |
| `pStreamGaugesIdField` | String |  | `ID` | Field of the stream gauges layer holding the station id, matching the ids of the CSV columns. |
| `inStreamGaugesCsv` | CSV file |  |  | CSV time series of the discharges of the stream gauges [m³/s]. |
